title: Limit Theorems for Tempered Linear Processes with Innovations in the Domain of Attraction of a Stable Law
summary: We study the partial-sum behavior of tempered linear processes \[ X_{N,n}=\sum_{j=1}^{\infty}e^{-λ_Nj}\frac{\ell(j)}{j}\varepsilon_{n-j}, \qquad λ_N\downarrow0, \] where $\ell$ is slowly varying and the innovations belong to the domain of attraction of an $α$-stable law with $1<α\leq2$. The filter $j^{-1}\ell(j)$ represents the logarithmic boundary between summable and power-law long-memory coefficients.
